(a) The UCS flight controls are those used by the UAV crew to operate the UAV with the semi-automatic mode of control as defined in USAR.1329
(b) The design of UCS flight controls must allow the UAV crew to rapidly and easily change the following flight parameters of the UAV (1) heading or track, (2) altitude, and, (3) airspeed.

(a) The UCS flight controls are those used by the UAS crew to operate the UA with the semi-automatic mode of control as defined in USAR.U1330
(b) The design of UCS flight controls must allow the UAS crew to rapidly and easily change the following flight parameters of the UA:
  (1) heading or track, (2) altitude, and (3) airspeed.
